_comment: Which recordings the app ships. One speaker per lesson, so a lesson has a
consistent voice while the course as a whole stays multi-speaker — learners
generalise better from varied talkers than from one.
"words": "*" takes everything that speaker recorded. Name words explicitly
to curate a subset. Run `python3 tools/build_audio.py --report` to see who

lessons.title: Existing vocabulary
_note: Not a lesson — recordings for words the app already taught before the
corpus arrived. "*" pools every speaker: these words are scattered
across contributors, and for a word the learner meets inside an older
category, having a native recording matters more than matching a voice.
